claims.content: A JU relinquishes R2 for a real-time track in accordance with the R2 rules, allowing another JU to assume R2 for that track.

goal.raw_text: A JU relinquishes R2 for a real-time track in accordance with the R2 rules, allowing another JU to assume R2 for that track.

claims.content: C2 JU
The C2 JU has assumed reporting responsibility for the Track Number.
No other JU is reporting the contact using that Track Number.
A C2 JU with R2 for a real-time track receives a remote track report with TQ greater than local TQ, or with TQ equal to local TQ from a JU whose Source TN is greater than the local Source TN.

trigger.raw_text: A C2 JU with R2 for a real-time track receives a remote track report with TQ greater than local TQ, or with TQ equal to local TQ from a JU whose Source TN is greater than the local Source TN.

claims.content: The C2 JU with R2 for a real-time track receives a remote track report with TQ greater than local TQ, or after applying all the above rules, receives a remote track report with TQ equal to the local TQ from a JU whose Source TN is greater than the local Source TN.
The C2 JU relinquishes R2 for the real-time track.
A JU with R2 on a track retains the responsibility until it is relinquished in accordance with the above rules or until the track is dropped.

Subsurface track reporting responsibility procedures are different from those for Air, Surface (Maritime), and Land (Ground) tracks; it is often desirable that more than one JU report the same Subsurface contact using different TNs. The first JU to report a contact assumes reporting responsibility for that Track Number, and no other JU shall report the contact using that track number unless a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message is received containing the TN.

For a ballistic missile track, a unit assuming R2 for the ballistic missile track need not assume R2 for the associated launch point, and the unit no longer holding R2 on the ballistic missile track may continue to report the launch point in accordance with the transmit/receive rules.
If, before relinquishment, the track is dropped, the C2 JU no longer holds R2 and no transfer occurs; the use case exits without transfer.

For reference points, lines, and areas, the originator of a J3.0 or J3.5 (PTI = 0) point, line, or area retains R2 as long as the originator remains active and reports the point, line, or area; the use case exits without R2 transfer.

After initially achieving Active status, or after returning to Active status from Inactive status or TDS Failure, or when deactivating a receive filter, a C2 JU capable of assuming R2 for air, surface, or land tracks shall not transmit air, surface, or land tracks until sufficient reporting responsibility checks, correlation, and data registration are performed; the minimum wait before reporting air and surface tracks is 12 seconds and for land tracks is 48 seconds. The exception path exits with no transmission before the minimum wait is satisfied.

If a J3.7 message is transmitted by a non-R2 JU with the Response Indicator set to value 1, it shall not affect reporting responsibility; the current R2 status remains unchanged and the use case exits without transfer.

If the track is an emergency point, any JU may report, through operator action only, on a previously reported emergency point when that JU has additional or more current information on the point. Additionally, another JU may assume R2 only by operator action when a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is received on the emergency point, the unit with R2 is declared inactive, or no periodic update is received for three consecutive update intervals; the JU assuming R2 shall use the same TN Reference and the same value of TN Previously Reported as those reported by the previous reporting unit. The latest JU to report a point has R2 for that point; the use case exits with the operator-action transfer.
The C2 JU relinquishes R2 for the real-time track.
The JU that transmitted the remote track report is a JU with R2 for the real-time track.
The C2 JU ceases reporting the track and transmits a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message on the surveillance TN.
